tagline: Imole fun aye nipase Oro Olorun.

onboarding.talkbackBody: Ohun elo yii n sise dara julo pelu ka-oju ipe sise. O le mu TalkBack sise ninu eto foonu re nigbakugba.

onboarding.languageReadAloud: Yan ede re. Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, tabi Geesi.
